title: Use path-based browser navigation for projects and views
description: Keep / as the project overview, and add stable path routes for opening a project, its views, tickets and planning documents. Direct links, refresh and browser back/forward must restore the requested route.
why: Starting plantool serve inside a project currently opens that project directly at /. The root must always show the project overview, and project resources need clear shareable URLs.

acceptance.text: GET / always serves the project overview, even when plantool serve starts inside a project
Project paths support summary, list, board, documents, decisions, design and roadmap views
A ticket can be opened at /<project_id>/<ticket_id>
Document detail and browser history follow canonical path routes
Unknown application paths return a useful not-found result

todos.text: Define and test the canonical route parser and URL builder
Serve the UI shell for valid project routes while preserving API routing
Update UI navigation, links and browser history to use paths
Update route documentation and verify full checks

outcome.summary: Added canonical path-based project, view, ticket and document navigation; root now opens the project overview.
outcome.verifiedBy: npm run check passed (122 passed, 1 skipped), including UI route parser, generated script parsing, server direct-route and 404 tests.
